vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an automatic LP burn feature that can be configured by the owner. By setting aggressive parameters (high burn frequency and high burn percentage), the owner can repeatedly burn LP tokens, reducing supply and increasing token price. The owner can then sell their tokens at the inflated price for profit.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the owner, enable trading, set aggressive LP burn parameters, acquire tokens, trigger the burn by selling, then sell more tokens to realize profit from the price increase.
step_by_step_plan:
1. Impersonate owner using vm.prank
2. Call enableTrading()
3. Set LP burn to max 10% every 10 minutes
4. Get MARVIN tokens via deal()
5. Warp time forward to pass burn frequency
6. Make a sell transaction to trigger autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens()
7. Sell more tokens to realize profit
8. Verify attacker balance increased
